item.description: Public schools have been a target for Immigration and Customs Enforcement in the Minneapolis suburb of Columbia Heights.

item.description: "Black in Blues" was released in paperback on Jan. 27.

item.title: European countries present new evidence showing Russian opposition leader was fatally poisoned
item.description: The finding directly challenges Russia's official account of his death, which was by natural causes.

item.title: How presidents have blurred the line between politician and celebrity
item.description: In a Vogue profile, reporter Maya Singer calls California Gov. Gavin Newsom "embarrassingly handsome." He's a possible 2028 presidential candidate.

item.description: Artificial intelligence could help judges at the Olympic Games more accurately assess technical performances.

item.title: How to build strength without lifting weights
item.description: Research shows bodyweight exercises can go a long way.

item.title: Birth control options for all: Planned Parenthood in Mass. now offers vasectomies
item.description: Planned Parenthoods in the state are now offering vasectomy services after they saw an a jump in requests for them after President Trump’s election in 2024. The procedures began Saturday, timed cheekily for Valentine’s Day.

item.title: How America sees itself through film
item.description: The National Film Registry names 25 movies each year that showcase the range and diversity of American filmmaking. How those movies reflect – and have shaped -- America’s history and culture.

item.title: Police: 3 killed, including suspect, in shooting at Pawtucket, R.I., hockey rink
item.description: Authorities said three people were fatally shot, including the suspect, during a youth hockey game Monday afternoon. Three others were injured and hospitalized in critical condition.
